meta.name: viral-x-posts
meta.description: Write viral X/Twitter posts using 23 proven plug-and-play formulas optimized for the 2025-2026 algorithm. Covers single tweets, threads, engagement bait, and media-enhanced formats. Use when the user asks to: write a tweet, draft an X post, create a thread, write viral content for Twitter/X, craft a hook, create engagement posts, write social media copy for X, brainstorm tweet ideas, or optimize existing tweets for virality. Also triggers on: "make this go viral", "tweet this", "X post", "Twitter thread", "write a banger tweet", "social media post".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把普通想法写成高互动率的X帖子
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的工作离不开X平台，想让每条内容都获得更多转发和点赞。
copy.tagline_en: Turn plain ideas into high-engagement X posts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your work depends on X and you want every post to get more retweets and likes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按你的目标（涨粉、求互动、立权威等）从 23 种现成模板里挑一个，帮你起草 X/Twitter 帖子，并自动套用算法优化规则，比如控制字数、把链接放到回复里、限制话题标签数量。
howto.when: 当你说“写条推特”“起草 X 帖子”“写个帖子”等要求，或提到“make this go viral”“tweet this”等触发词时，它会接管并开始起草。

say.text: 帮我写条推文，目标是吸引更多粉丝。
say.note: Claude 会确认目标并选模板起草。

say.text: 把这几句话改成 X 帖子，要能钓回复。
say.note: 它会选用互动类公式并套用。

say.text: 给我 3 个推特开头，主题是自律。
say.note: 它会从 hook 库里挑开头给你。

howto.what_en: Claude will pick from 23 formulas based on your goal, draft X/Twitter posts, and apply rules like character limits, links in replies, and limited hashtags.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write a tweet, draft an X post, create a thread, or say phrases like "make this go viral" or "tweet this".

say_en.text: Write a tweet to gain more followers.
say_en.note: Claude will ask your goal and draft.

say_en.text: Turn this into an X post that gets replies.
say_en.note: It will use an engagement formula.

say_en.text: Give me 3 post hooks about discipline.
say_en.note: It will pull from the hook library.
